A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a fast factorization architecture for soft-decision RS decoder based on root-order-prediction, which can be applied to any KV-based RS decoders.
the proposed architecture can speed up soft-decision RS factorization by 141% while reducing the area consumption by 31.4%.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the root-order prediction technique can be utilized as a generic tool in speeding up factorization in soft-decision RS decoders.

, by exploiting the inherent correlation between the roots of the factorization polynomial and the roots of the original polynomial, a significant reduction in the factorization latency can be achieved.
